Property.name: DatabaseLatencyMax
Property.Description:
Number of files behind the primary this backup is in dejournaling into the databases.
A low number here would be appropriate. Somewhere between 1 and 10 depending on the perceived
reaction time of on call resources.

Property.name: JournalFilesLatencyMax
Property.Description:
Number of files behind the primary this backup is in retrieveing journal files from the primary.
A low number here would be appropriate. Somewhere between 1 and 10 depending on the perceived
reaction time of on call resources.

Property.name: Recipient
Property.Description:
The email address(es) of a recipient or a comma and/or semicolon separated list of recipients
that will be added to the To: list of each mail message sent.
If none, no email will be sent.

Property.name: From
Property.Description: The default From: address to put in sent mail messages.

Property.name: TriggerAlert
Property.Description: Trigger APE alert if monitoring criteria is met

Property.name: StatusServiceURL
Property.Description: URL to the mirror status query service
